Shipping Policy – Fabrixa Store

At Fabrixa Store, we are committed to delivering your orders safely and on time across India.

Order Processing


  • Orders are usually processed within 1–3 business days after payment confirmation.

  • Orders placed on weekends or public holidays will be processed on the next working day.

Shipping Time

Estimated delivery timelines:


  • Metro Cities: 3–5 business days

  • Other Cities & Towns: 5–8 business days

  • Remote Areas: 7–10 business days

Delivery timelines may vary during festivals, sales, or due to courier delays.

Shipping Charges


  • We may offer free shipping on selected products or order values.

  • Any applicable shipping charges will be shown during checkout before payment.

Order Tracking

Once your order is shipped, you will receive:


  • Tracking ID

  • Courier partner details

  • Tracking link via Email/SMS/WhatsApp

Delivery Partners

We work with trusted courier partners to ensure safe and timely delivery across India.

Delayed or Failed Deliveries

Fabrixa Store is not responsible for delays caused by:


  • Natural disasters

  • Weather conditions

  • Courier service disruptions

  • Incorrect shipping address provided by the customer

If delivery fails due to an incorrect address or unavailable recipient, additional shipping charges may apply for re-shipping.

Address Changes

Customers must contact us within 12 hours of placing the order for any address modifications.

Damaged or Missing Products

If you receive:


  • A damaged item

  • Wrong product

  • Missing item

Please contact us within 48 hours of delivery with:


  • Order number

  • Product photos/videos

  • Package images

Contact Us

For shipping-related support:


  • Email: info@fabrixastore.com

  • Phone: +91 6354947103
